mainEntity.name: How do I choose the right provider for an AEO website audit?

acceptedAnswer.text: When choosing an AEO website audit provider, look for a company with a proven track record in both traditional SEO and advanced AI-driven strategies. Evaluate their understanding of large language models and entity recognition, not just keywords. Request case studies or examples of their audit reports to assess depth and actionable insights. Ensure they offer customized solutions rather than one-size-fits-all approaches, and prioritize clear communication regarding process, timelines, and expected outcomes.
acceptedAnswer.description: Choose a provider with expertise in both SEO and AI strategies, a deep understanding of large language models, and a track record of delivering actionable, customized audit reports.
